Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Ascendia's evaluation committee would like to run a short vendor bakeoff next week to compare latency/cost during a live workload. The committee has asked that we get CTO-level presence (our CTO will join) and ideally Redwood brings a technical sponsor (CTO/Head of Infra level) to speak to architecture and scaling.

We're targeting a 60–75 minute slot: 20 min overview + 30 min live run with our dataset + 15 min Q&A. Would you be able to bring someone at that level and cover fallback routing and batching?

Proposed window: Tue Apr 27 between 10:00–16:00 PT. We have a tight schedule (vendor slots back-to-back) so we need a firm slot.

Happy to share a short agenda and our test harness.

—Claire
